_description: Java Spark APIs confirmed compatible with Snowpark Connect for Spark (SCOS) — verified against the SCOS relation/expression mapper, behavioral-differences doc, and the official SCOS Java DataFrame/Dataset support reference. Blocks containing ONLY these APIs skip ALL compatibility analysis. Bar is strict: an entry stays only if SCOS is result-identical to Spark and never raises where Spark would not. APIs with known behavioral differences (regex, date/time, numeric precision, temp-view resolution, file I/O semantics) are NOT eligible even if they appear in the 'compatible' list in Snowflake docs. NOTE: support in Apache Spark Connect does NOT imply SCOS support.
